meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划拆给多个子代理并行执行,并留下执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有一份写好的工作计划,想让它被自动跑完
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan across parallel subagents and keep an evidence log
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you already have a written plan and want it executed for you

howto.what: Claude 会变成只做调度的执行者：读取 .omo/plans 下的工作计划，把每个任务派给并行的子代理去做，自己只记录进度、收集证据、勾选完成项，不亲手改代码。
howto.when: 当你说 “ulw-execute”、要求执行 .omo/plans 下的计划，或说 “start work” 时接管；若没有可用计划，它会先调用 ulw-plan 生成一份。

say.note: 启动该技能，挑选并执行已有计划

say.text: 执行 .omo/plans 里的 my-plan 计划
say.note: 它会按计划逐项派活并推进
交付到 PR 打开并跟进到合并

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a pure orchestrator: it reads a plan under .omo/plans, delegates every task to parallel subagents, tracks Boulder state and an evidence ledger, and ticks checkboxes. It never edits product files itself.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say “ulw-execute”, ask to run a plan under .omo/plans, or say “start work”; with no plan available it first bootstraps ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Starts the skill and picks a plan to run
It dispatches each item and drives it forward
Delivers through an opened PR to merge
